+title: Stop installing swiftformat in CI
+---
+## What
+
+`.github/workflows/ci.yml` installs `swiftformat` with Homebrew on the self-hosted macOS runner, at lines 116 to 118. No rule uses that tool after the task "Move idioms-swift to the toolchain swift format". Remove the install.
+
+Files to change:
+- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
+
+Remove only the `swiftformat` block:
+
+```
+if ! command -v swiftformat &>/dev/null; then
+  brew install swiftformat
+fi
+```
+
+KEEP the `swiftlint` install at lines 113 to 115, because `disallowed-constructs-swift`, `function-length-swift` and `magic-numbers-swift` still run it. KEEP the `periphery` install at lines 119 to 126, with its `brew uninstall --cask` line, because `dead-code-swift` still runs it. The comment at line 108 states which tools ship only through Homebrew; correct that comment for the new set.
+
+The `swift --version` step at line 106 stays, and it becomes more important: the toolchain is now the formatter. If the task above sets a Swift version floor, make the workflow fail with a clear message when the runner is below that floor.
+
+Do this task last of the tool tasks, because CI must keep installing `swiftformat` until no rule runs it.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `.github/workflows/ci.yml` names `swiftformat` nowhere.
+- [ ] The workflow still installs `swiftlint` and `periphery`.
+- [ ] The comment above the install block names the correct set of Homebrew tools.
+- [ ] CI passes on the self-hosted macOS runner, and every Swift tool rule reports as healthy.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Run `rg swiftformat .github/`. The command finds nothing.
+- [ ] Run the full Swift test set on the runner: `cargo test -p swissarmyhammer-validators swift`. Every test passes with no `swiftformat` on the PATH.
+- [ ] Run `sah doctor` on the runner. Every Swift tool rule reports as healthy.
+- [ ] Push the branch and read the CI result. The macOS job is green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write the failing tests first, then write the code that makes them pass. #swift
\ No newline at end of file
